actions.description: Query a chart result by ID.
actions.name: query-chart

chart_id.description: The saved chart ID to query. Found in the chart URL in the Amplitude web app. Example: "abc123".

ActionInput_amplitude_querychart.description: Input to query an Amplitude chart by its saved chart ID.

series.description: Array of metric series, one per group. Each inner array contains values for each x-axis interval.

series_meta.description: Metadata labels for each series group, such as segment indices or region names.

series_labels.description: Human-readable labels for each series group.

x_values.description: X-axis values, typically dates in YYYY-MM-DD format or interval strings.

chart_data.description: Complete chart response object when the provider returns a non-standard shape.

ActionOutput_amplitude_querychart.description: Chart query result containing normalized series, metadata, and the raw provider payload.

actions.description: Restore a deleted event property in taxonomy.
actions.name: restore-event-property

event_property.description: Name of the event property to restore. Example: "Completed Task"

event_type.description: Optional name of the event type. When included, restores the property for the specified event type. When omitted, restores the shared event property.

actions.description: Restore a deleted taxonomy event type.
actions.name: restore-event-type

event_type.description: The event type to restore. Example: "Purchase"

actions.description: Restore a deleted user property in taxonomy.
actions.name: restore-user-property

user_property.description: The user property name. Prefix custom user properties with gp:.

actions.description: Search for users by Amplitude ID, device ID, user ID, or user ID prefix.
actions.name: search-users

user.description: Amplitude ID, Device ID, User ID, or User ID prefix to search for. Example: "myusername" or "356893043036"

ActionInput_amplitude_searchusers.description: Input for searching Amplitude users by identifier.

user_id.description: The user ID of the matching user.

amplitude_id.description: The Amplitude ID of the matching user.

matches.description: Array of matching users. Empty when no users are found.

type.description: The match type that yielded the result, e.g. "match_user_or_device_id" or "nomatch".

ActionOutput_amplitude_searchusers.description: Result of an Amplitude user search, including matched users and the match type.

actions.description: Send an event to Amplitude.
actions.name: track-event

user_id.description: Amplitude user ID. Required if device_id is not provided.

device_id.description: Amplitude device ID. Required if user_id is not provided.

event_type.description: The type of event. Example: "Button Clicked"

time.description: Event timestamp in milliseconds since epoch.

insert_id.description: A unique identifier for the event.

actions.description: Update an annotation category
actions.name: update-annotation-category

category_id.description: The ID of the annotation category to update. Example: 123

category.description: The new name for the annotation category. Example: "Updated Category Name"

actions.description: Update a chart annotation.
actions.name: update-annotation

annotation_id.description: The ID of the annotation to update. Example: 939879

start.description: Timestamp for the start of the annotation in ISO 8601 format. Example: "2026-06-16T00:00:00+00:00"

category.description: The name of the category that the annotation belongs to.

chart_id.description: The ID of the chart to annotate. Set to null to make the annotation global.

end.description: Timestamp for the end of the annotation in ISO 8601 format. Set to null to remove the end time. Example: "2026-06-16T23:59:59+00:00"

actions.description: Update an event category.
actions.name: update-event-category

category_id.description: The ID of the category to update. Example: 412931

category_name.description: The new name of the category. Example: "Updated Category"

actions.description: Update an event property in taxonomy.
actions.name: update-event-property

event_property.description: Name of the event property to update. Example: "Completed Task"

event_type.description: Name of the event type the event property belongs to. Example: "Onboard Start"

override_scope.description: Determines how Amplitude acts on this event property. Only applicable when event_type is present.

new_event_property_value.description: The new name of the event property.

regex.description: Regular expression for pattern matching. Only applicable to the string type.

enum_values.description: List of allowed values, separated by comma. Only applicable to the enum type.

is_array_type.description: Specifies whether the property value is an array.

is_hidden.description: Hide the property from chart dropdowns.

classifications.description: List of classifications applicable to this event property, separated by comma. Valid classifications are PII, SENSITIVE, and REVENUE.

actions.description: Update a taxonomy event type.
actions.name: update-event-type

event_type.description: The event type name to update. Example: "Purchase"

category.description: Current category name of the event type.

description.description: Details to add to the event type.

display_name.description: Display name of the event type.

is_hidden_from_dropdowns.description: Event type is hidden from dropdowns.

is_hidden_from_persona_results.description: Event type is hidden from persona results.

is_hidden_from_pathfinder.description: Event type is hidden from pathfinder.

is_hidden_from_timeline.description: Event type is hidden from timeline.

tags.description: List of tags, separated by a comma.

actions.description: Update a group property in taxonomy.
actions.name: update-group-property

group_property.description: Name of the group property. Prefix custom group properties with grp:.

group_type.description: Name of the group type the group property belongs to.

override_scope.description: Determines how Amplitude acts on this group property. Values: "override", "shared".

new_group_property_value.description: The new name of the group property.

type.description: Data type of the group property. Values: any, string, number, boolean, enum.

regex.description: Regular expression for pattern matching. Applies only to string type.

enum_values.description: List of allowed values, separated by comma. Only applicable to enum type.

is_hidden.description: Hide the property from chart dropdowns.

classifications.description: List of classifications applicable to this group property. Valid values: PII, SENSITIVE, REVENUE.

actions.description: Update a user property in taxonomy.
actions.name: update-user-property

user_property.description: The user property name. Prefix custom user properties with gp:. Example: "device_id"

new_user_property_value.description: New name of the user property type.

description.description: Details to add to the user property type.

regex.description: Regular expression or custom regex used for pattern matching.

enum_values.description: List of allowed values, separated by comma.

is_array_type.description: Specifies whether the property value is an array.

is_hidden.description: Hide the property from chart dropdowns.

classifications.description: List of classifications applicable to this user property. Valid values are PII, SENSITIVE and REVENUE.

id.description: Stable identifier for the event type (event_type name)

event_type.description: The event type name

is_active.description: Whether the event type is active

deleted.description: Whether the event type is deleted

showDeleted.description: Include deleted event types in the response
